name: Mobile Money and Remittance (MVTS) Abuse
description: Money or value transfer services and mobile money wallets move funds quickly across borders, often to cash-based endpoints. Offenders use them to send scam proceeds, structure payments through many senders and receivers, and operate unlicensed or complicit agents. Cyber-enabled aspects include compromised wallets, SIM swaps and automated account farms.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Money or Value Transfer Services (2016)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Prepaid Cards, Mobile Payments and Internet-Based Payment Services (2013)
FATF, Recommendation 16 and Interpretive Note on payment transparency

indicators.name: Many senders paying one beneficiary or many beneficiaries paid by one sender
indicators.canon: Many unrelated senders paying a single account or recipient
indicators.desc: Numerous unrelated payers send frequent, often small, payments to one account, wallet or beneficiary, or one funder pays many beneficiaries, with no clear commercial relationship.
indicators.ctx: Fan-in or fan-out structures with no family or business link.
indicators.fp: Diaspora family support or charity collection.

indicators.name: Transfers just under identification or reporting thresholds
indicators.canon: Non-cash transfers or loads just below identification or reporting thresholds
indicators.desc: Repeated transfers, remittances or card/wallet loads kept just below an identification, record-keeping or travel-rule threshold.
indicators.ctx: Repeated sends sized to avoid additional checks.

indicators.name: Sender profile does not match volume or purpose
indicators.canon: Account activity inconsistent with declared occupation or income
indicators.desc: Turnover or volumes materially exceed what the customer's declared occupation, income, age or circumstances would support.
indicators.ctx: Low-income or newly joined sender moves large sums with vague purpose.

indicators.name: Wallet SIM swap followed by outbound transfers
indicators.canon: SIM swap or number port before transfers
indicators.desc: Mobile number is ported or SIM replaced shortly before one-time-passcode-protected actions or outbound transfers.
indicators.ctx: Number is ported or SIM replaced, then funds drained to new payees.

indicators.name: Agent with unusual cash volumes or splitting behaviour
indicators.canon: Agent with unusual cash volumes or splitting behaviour
indicators.desc: Agent location processes volumes far above peers, with suspicious customer splitting.
indicators.ctx: Agent location processes volumes far above peers, with suspicious customer splitting.

indicators.name: Beneficiary account in high-risk or uncooperative jurisdiction
indicators.canon: Counterparty or flows in higher-risk jurisdictions with weak AML controls
indicators.desc: Funds, counterparties or institutions are located in jurisdictions with weak AML supervision, sanctions exposure or limited VASP regulation.
indicators.ctx: Receiving corridors are known for weak controls or sanctions risk.

indicators.name: Same device or phone used by many senders
indicators.canon: Shared device, contact or address data across many applicants or senders
indicators.desc: The same device fingerprint, IP, phone, email or address appears across many applications, claims or apparent customers.
indicators.ctx: Single device initiates transfers for multiple apparent customers.

indicators.name: Rapid wallet-to-wallet hops then cash-out at agent
indicators.canon: Rapid stored-value or wallet hops then cash-out
indicators.desc: Stored value or funds move quickly between wallets or cards and are then cashed out.
indicators.ctx: Value passes through several mobile wallets within hours before cash-out.

indicators.name: Missing or inconsistent originator and beneficiary information
indicators.canon: Missing, incomplete or placeholder originator and beneficiary information
indicators.desc: Payment messages omit, truncate or use generic placeholder data for originator or beneficiary details.
indicators.ctx: Payment messages incomplete, inconsistent or use placeholder data.

indicators.name: Unlicensed or unregistered operator behaviour
indicators.desc: Individuals operate collection points or chat-app based services with no licence.
indicators.ctx: Individuals operate collection points or chat-app based services with no licence.
